summary.finding: No included paper used an unavailable fine image to score errors of a genuinely coarse received image while presenting the comparison as a matched deployable reliability baseline.
summary.interpretation: The audit supports a concrete counterexample and protocol checklist, not a prevalence estimate or claim that published EO methods commonly make this mistake.
